_comments: bc-aidp-next-golive#259 item 3: the Commercial section's Currency renders as an empty text box,
and would render a raw GUID if anything ever filled it. Same structural cause as the two contract
fields, and the same remedy.
Deal.CurrencyID is a SOFT reference -- its own column comment says so -- because currency reference
data belongs to ACCOUNTING, which sits below sales in the dependency graph and knows nothing about
deals. No database FK means CodeGen sets no RelatedEntityID, and mj-form-field with no related
entity has no name to show, nowhere to go, and no picker to offer. It falls back to a text box.
IsSoftForeignKey=1 plus AutoUpdateRelatedEntityInfo=0 is the pair that makes this stick: the first
declares the link deliberate, the second tells CodeGen not to re-derive it from a constraint that
does not exist and will never exist.
WHAT THIS DOES NOT DO: it creates no constraint and nothing to violate. The database is untouched.
It also does not SET a currency on anything -- a deal created tomorrow still arrives with the field
null. Defaulting it is server-side work (DealEntityServer), deliberately separate, because a picker
that works and a value that is chosen for you are two different fixes and only one of them belongs
in metadata.
Accounting is a declared dependency in mj-app.json, so naming its entity here is legitimate. The
matching declaration in codegen-schema-info.json is what re-applies this after a rebuild-from-zero,
and it SKIPS with a warning on a host where accounting is absent rather than failing.
The related entity's name field is Name ('US Dollar'), with Code, Symbol and Decimal Places already
flagged DefaultInView -- so the picker reads as a currency list, not a list of ids, with no further
metadata needed on the accounting side.
